_comment: Technical validation of the pixel path on the COBRA BCC subset (real_image_technical: NO label is read).
Prerequisites: (1) the COBRA subset is imported with `python -m dermpath.importers.cobra ... --project
proj-cobra-bcc-subset` and its ingest and QC jobs have finished; (2) a dataset version of that project is
frozen (the most recently frozen version is used; replace "dataset" with {"name": ..., "version": ...} or
"dataset_version_id" to pin another); (3) midnight-12k needs its weights directory in WB_MIDNIGHT_WEIGHTS
(obtained separately under the model's licence; nothing is downloaded). Without them the command stops with
encoder_unavailable. COBRA is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: non-commercial research only.
Builds one feature set per encoder with the SAME patch and sampling policy (patch_size follows each encoder's
input size), reports coverage diagnostics and re-extracts a seeded subset to check determinism.
name: COBRA subset technical validation
description: Extraction, coverage, determinism, throughput and memory of handcrafted-stain-texture-v1 and midnight-12k on real COBRA slides. No labels, no heads, no metrics.
